course.learn: Technical implications are the downstream effects a change can have on systems, dependencies, compatibility, downtime, and security policy. A change that is safe in isolation may break another application or control.
course.why: Understanding dependencies prevents a security improvement from accidentally causing an outage or bypass.
course.example: Blocking a legacy protocol improves security but also breaks an old application that still depends on that port, so the change must be planned and tested.
course.exam: When CompTIA asks what to consider before a change, think dependencies, legacy systems, restarts, downtime, allow/deny lists, and rollback.

course.check_a: Technical implications are the downstream effects a change can have on systems, dependencies, compatibility, downtime, and security policy.
